title: Julia Spina Breaks Down 20 Years of VIX Expansions
description:
Julia Spina walks through a study of VIX expansions and contractions from 2005 to 2025, and one number does most of the work. At an average VIX near 20, a spike and a drop are close to equally likely, and that holds whether you look at seven day, fifteen day or thirty day windows.

Below 13, expansions dominate. Above 25, contractions take over. And the higher the VIX goes, the shorter those moves tend to last, which makes duration the real decision. Study by Sahil. Education, not a recommendation.
